finalProject.prompt: Explain how Michael Jackson revolutionized global pop music through his vocal innovations, choreography language, and cinematic storytelling. Compare ONE Quincy-era track (‘Billie Jean,’ ‘Human Nature,’ or ‘Smooth Criminal’) with ONE post-Quincy social commentary track (‘Earth Song,’ ‘They Don’t Care About Us’). Identify THREE modern artists whose entire careers or performance styles are directly built on MJ’s blueprint.
